images.name: so-i-guess-my-goals-are-to-be-fast-and-win-everything
images.joke: So I guess my goals are to be fast and win everything! / Great. That's really helpful.
images.alt: A smiling woman on a video call says: "So I guess my goals are to be fast and win everything!" Cartoon Gravel God, seen from behind at his desk, replies: "Great. That's really helpful."

images.name: process
images.joke: It's the process people. PROCESS PROCESS PROCESS!
images.alt: Cartoon Gravel God shouts and points over the words "It's the process people. PROCESS PROCESS PROCESS!"
images.note: The rig has no megaphone, so he shouts and points instead; the words are re-set in the site's serif because the original sans font is not available to the renderer.

images.name: pileomillers
images.alt: Friends laugh around a campfire above glittering city lights at night, while cartoon Gravel God sips a beer beside a pile of Miller Lite cans and cheese.

images.name: no-idea
images.alt: Cartoon Gravel God shrugs as tomatoes fly at him, saying: "I have no idea."

images.name: beyond-help
images.joke: I think you're beyond the help of not just me, but the entire field.
images.alt: A doctor in a white coat sits at his desk facing cartoon Gravel God, seen from behind, and says: "I think you're beyond the help of not just me, but the entire field."
images.note: The doctor's desk front, which the old hat brim covered, is a plain grey panel.

images.name: all-i-had-for-breakfast-was-a-big-gust-of-wind
images.joke: I shared my breakfast with a garbage can.
images.alt: A weight chart falling from about 186 lbs in November 2017 to 169 lbs by March 2018; cartoon Gravel God stands by a trash can with a donut, saying: "I shared my breakfast with a garbage can."
images.note: The original was a short animation; the redraw is a still.

images.name: so-i-guess-my-goals-are-to-be-fast-and-win-everything-1
images.joke: GOALS: UPGRADE TO CAT 1 / FACTORS: TRAINING, SLEEP, BODY COMP, RACE TACTICS, MENTAL GAME, ETC. / PROCESS GOAL: IMPROVE BODY COMP / HABIT: WEIGH MYSELF EVERY MORNING
images.alt: A chalkboard reads "GOALS: UPGRADE TO CAT 1. FACTORS: TRAINING, SLEEP, BODY COMP, RACE TACTICS, MENTAL GAME, ETC. PROCESS GOAL: IMPROVE BODY COMP. HABIT: WEIGH MYSELF EVERY MORNING", with a grinning cartoon Gravel God beside it.

images.name: dream-big
images.alt: Cartoon Gravel God straddles his road bike in the middle of an empty highway under a stormy sky, with "DREAM BIG" painted on the asphalt.
